meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先同步最新 LazyCodex 与 Codex 源码,再检查本地安装的版本、配置、插件负载、命令行链接等,输出每项结论都附证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 诊断报告。只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 做一次健康检查
say.note: 输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 我的 Codex 更新后行为有点怪,帮我诊断一下
say.note: 先同步最新源码,再对比本地安装

say.text: 检查我的 Astra 配置是否就绪
say.note: 对比 codex 版本与 0.153.1 下限

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude syncs the latest LazyCodex and Codex sources, inspects your local install, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites its evidence. Diagnosis only: it never edits your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, or when Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex install.
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence

say_en.text: My Codex acts odd after an update, please diagnose it.
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then compares your install

say_en.text: Check whether my Astra setup is ready.
say_en.note: Compares codex version against the 0.153.1 floor
